title: Allowance Carried into a New Lot from What the Account Already Holds
content:
A new allowance lot on an Employee Meal Account may open with something already in it, either because the plan lets unspent allowance roll forward or because a refund has put employer allowance back on the account.

**Clause.** Where the plan allows unspent allowance to roll over and allowance stands unspent on the account, the amount carried into the new lot is that unspent allowance. Where the plan does not allow unspent allowance to roll over and a refund restoring allowance has been posted on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the amount carried in is that restored allowance, since allowance restored by a refund is granted back rather than written off. Where neither holds, nothing is carried in.

## Which plans let unspent allowance roll forward

| Meal plan | Unspent allowance rolls into the next grant period |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | no |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | no |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | no |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes |

## The bands

| Plan allows rollover | What the account shows | Carried into the new lot |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Unspent allowance standing above nothing | That unspent allowance |
| Yes | No unspent allowance standing | Nothing |
| No | A refund restoring employer allowance posted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | That restored allowance |
| No | No such refund in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Nothing |

The refund looked for is one that restores employer allowance rather than one returned to stored value or to a card, and it is looked for in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and no further back.

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan allowing rollover, an account holding $63.00 of unspent allowance carries $63.00 into the new lot. On a plan not allowing rollover, an account on which $7.40 of allowance was restored by a refund last week carries $7.40 in; with no such refund in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, it carries nothing in.
